source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 9.3 with Figs. 9.10 to 9.13 (PDF 198-200).

blocks.text: Jab electric field mein kisi area ka chhota tukra (element of area) rakhein to kuch lines of force us mein se guzarti hain (Fig. 9.10). Kisi area se guzarne wali field lines ki tadaad ko us area se electric flux kehte hain. Ise Greek harf φₑ se likhte hain. Misal: Fig. 9.10 mein area A se flux 4 hai aur area B se 2.

blocks.alt: Magenta field lines oopar jati aur phailti hain. Neeche jahan qareeb hain, chhota peela raqba A 4 lines se guzarta hai. Oopar jahan door hain, barabar peela raqba B 2 lines se.
blocks.caption: Figure 9.10: E ke amudi sath se electric flux (kitab ki Figure 9.10 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Flux yani area se guzarne wali lines ki tadaad: A se 4 aur B se 2. Dono area barabar hain, magar A par lines ghani hain, is liye wahan field zyada taqatwar hai.

Flux ko number ki shakal dene ke liye lines aise banayi jati hain ke field lines ke seedhe (perpendicular) rakhe unit area se guzarne wali lines ki tadaad us point par field ki intensity E ke barabar ho.
Area ke tukre ko aam taur par vector area A se dikhate hain: is ki miqdar tukre ke area A ke barabar hoti hai aur simt area ke normal (satah par seedhi khadi lakeer) ke saath hoti hai.
Fig. 9.11(a) mein area A field lines ke seedha (perpendicular) rakha hai, is liye EA lines us se guzarti hain. Yahan flux:
Fig. 9.11(b) mein area A field lines ke mutawazi (parallel) rakha hai; koi line is area ko paar nahi karti, is liye flux zero hai:

Fig. 9.11(c) mein A na seedha hai na mutawazi, balke field E se angle θ par jhuka hua hai. Yahan area ka woh saya (projection) lete hain jo field lines ke seedha ho. Is saye ka area A cosθ hai. Yahan flux:

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab in teen equations ko numbers (9.7), (9.8) aur (9.9) deti hai, magar yeh numbers is chapter mein pehle hi medium mein force, E = F/q aur F = qE ko mil chuke hain. Equations sahi hain, sirf numbers dobara istemal hue hain. Case (b) mein kitab "EA = 0" likhti hai; murad hai E·A = EA cos90° = 0.

blocks.alt: Teen hisse, magenta field teer E daen taraf. (a) Maximum: hara raqba field ke aar paar khara, vector A daen taraf E ke saath. (b) Minimum: raqba field ke mutawazi leta hua, A seedha oopar. (c) Raqba jhuka hua, A aur E ke darmiyan zaviya theta; saath peeli dashed patti A cos theta, yani E ke amudi us ka saya (projection).
blocks.caption: Figure 9.11: (a) zyada se zyada; (b) kam se kam; (c) (kitab ki Figure 9.11 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: (a) mein saari lines area se guzarti hain: φ = EA (sab se zyada). (b) mein koi line nahi guzarti: φ = 0 (sab se kam). (c) mein sirf seedha saya A cosθ kaam karta hai: φ = EA cosθ.
Is tarah chapte (flat) tukre se electric flux E aur A ki madad se yeh hai:
Yahan θ field lines aur area ke normal ke darmiyan angle hai. Flux do vectors ka scalar product hai, is liye flux scalar quantity hai (is ki koi simt nahi). Is ki SI unit N m² C⁻¹ hai.
Charge ko gherne wali surface se electric flux

Ab radius r wale sphere (gola) ki band surface se flux nikalte hain, jab point charge q sphere ke markaz (centre) par ho (Fig. 9.12). φₑ = E·A sirf chapti surface par lagta hai, is liye sphere ki poori surface ko n chhote tukron mein baant dete hain jin ke area ΔA₁, ΔA₂, ΔA₃, …, ΔAₙ hain. Har vector area tukre se bahar ki taraf seedha hai. In tukron ke markaz par fields E₁, E₂, E₃, …, Eₙ hain.

blocks.alt: Bara saya-daar kurra, markaz par +q. Sath ke chhote tukre Delta A par siyah teer Delta A aur surkh teer E dono seedhe bahar.
blocks.caption: Figure 9.12: markaz par charge q ki wajah se kurre ki sath se kul flux q/ε0 hai (kitab ki Figure 9.12 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har tukre par E aur ΔA dono bahar ki taraf hain, is liye θ = 0 aur har tukre ka flux EΔA hai. Saare tukre jorne se E × 4πr² = q/ε₀ milta hai.
Eq. 9.10 ke mutabiq band surface se kul flux:
Har tukre par E aur vector area ki simt ek hai. Aur sab tukre charge se barabar faasle r par hain, is liye har jagah field ki miqdar barabar hai:
E vector area ke mutawazi hai, is liye θ = 0° aur har tukre ke liye:

blocks.latex: \phi_e = E\Delta A_1 + E\Delta A_2 + \dots + E\Delta A_n = E\,(\Delta A_1 + \Delta A_2 + \dots + \Delta A_n)
blocks.text_alt: φₑ = EΔA₁ + EΔA₂ + … + EΔAₙ = E (ΔA₁ + ΔA₂ + … + ΔAₙ)

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Dekhein: r cut gaya. Sphere bara ho ya chhota, flux q/ε₀ hi rehta hai. Bare sphere par field kamzor hai magar area utna hi zyada hai.

Ab sochein ke ek band surface S is sphere ko ghere hue hai. Fig. 9.13 mein dikhta hai ke jo lines sphere se nikalti hain wohi S se bhi nikalti hain, is liye S se flux wahi hai jo sphere se. Nateeja: band surface se kul flux us surface ki shakal par munhasir nahi; yeh sirf medium aur andar band charge par munhasir hai.

blocks.alt: Be-qaida gulabi band sath S ek halke hare kurre ko gherti hai jis ke markaz par +q hai. Seedhi magenta lines +q se kurre aur S dono ke paar bahar jati hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 9.13 (kitab ki Figure 9.13 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Jo line sphere se nikalti hai wohi S se bhi nikalti hai, is liye S se flux bhi q/ε₀ hai.

blocks.prompt: 10 cm² area ki disc ek seedhi khadi (vertical) field E = 5 × 10⁵ N C⁻¹ mein rakhi hai aur us ki satah horizontal se 30° par hai. Disc se flux nikalein (numerical 9.6).
blocks.explanation: Disc ka normal vertical field se 30° banata hai, is liye φ = EA cos30° = 5 × 10⁵ N C⁻¹ × 10 × 10⁻⁴ m² × 0.866 = 433 N m² C⁻¹ (= 250√3 N m² C⁻¹).

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Flux: area se guzarne wali field lines ki tadaad; vector A normal ki simt mein.
Seedha area: φ = EA (sab se zyada); mutawazi: φ = 0; jhuka hua: φ = EA cosθ = E·A (9.10); scalar, unit N m² C⁻¹.
Sphere ke markaz par charge q: φ = E × 4πr² = q/ε₀ (9.13); charge ko gherne wali kisi bhi band surface ke liye yehi flux; sirf medium aur andar ke charge par munhasir.
